title: Conditional κ = 7.10346593569665e-4: fixed-prime refinement on PR244
body:
## Conditional result

This stacks on [PR244](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/244), commit `a568d94f941929232ab393c7d33dc5a30e017892`, and refines its retimed 5,891,100-call source527 profile. The exact candidate is

- PR244 base: `710346589668175/10^18`
- Fixed prime with `eta = 10^-12`: `710346593567535/10^18`
- Final with `eta = 10^-24`: `710346593569665/10^18`
- Exact gain over PR244: `3901490/10^18`

The gain splits into `3899360/10^18` from replacing the inherited rare-class density envelope with `2m^3/q`, and `2130/10^18` from rechecking PR243's smaller outer backoff on PR244's profile. κ is still a conditional finite result, not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

## Mathematical and physical certificate

The inherited profile has `m=120`, normalized stock `W=260987`, rank mass `31265640`, deficit `52800`, largest child `50`, and 60 literal physical replicas with stock `1304935`. It retains every bank selector call (`525064856400`) and the complete `32m^2` rare-case fallback; this refinement changes only their justified frequency bound, not the physical word or fallback inventory.

The fixed prime is `q=2^127-1=170141183460469231731687303715884105727`, chosen before the input or atom width. Its per-edge rare-class density is `rho=3456000/q < 10^-16`. The certificate independently recomputes two rational moment bounds, a five-level finite ordinary recurrence, all 47 strict assembly inequalities and seven margins, and rejection of the adjacent `10^-18` κ grid point. The finite coefficient is `93574191906738001 < 2^80`.

The pinned parent verifier reconstructs PR244's 364 frame changes and independent complete path census, then checks the F₂ helper, literal inverse, restored sources and dirty registers, prime witnesses, all 4,976,100 bank assignments, routes, complex supplier, and finite bill. The original PR244 package reports two identical full eight-stage replays.

## Reproduction and CI

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/five-stage-source527-fixed-prime/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/five-stage-source527-fixed-prime/verify.py --output /tmp/source527-fixed-prime-run
```

The new `source527-fixed-prime` workflow runs that full pinned replay and exact refinement, and separately kernel-checks `Prime.lean` using pinned Lean 4.24.0/mathlib. The repository's standard PR workflow also covers all 16 `make verify` targets across Python 3.11, 3.13, and 3.14, plus its formal, ranked-pair, certificate, and immutable-offline jobs. The upstream `pull_request` Actions are gated with `action_required`; GitHub's workflow-run approval API returned 403 because this account lacks repository-admin rights. I have not treated that gate as a pass. To complete validation, the exact head commit is running in the contributor fork: [the full source replay, exact refinement, and Lean prime proof](https://github.com/sennemmi/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38007590993) and [the repository-wide verification matrix](https://github.com/sennemmi/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38007590974) are queued. I will add their final results here.

Local preflight checked the exact rational certificate, both moment engines, the backoff decomposition, finite cutoffs, all 47 constraints and seven margins, package and source hashes, Python syntax, and `git diff --check`. The expensive eight-stage parent replay is delegated to the Draft CI rather than repeated locally.

## Attribution, licence, and limits

Apache-2.0. The physical construction is stacked from eumemic's PR244 retiming and PR210 source527/bank work. The fixed-prime method and byte-pinned `Prime.lean` come from Gabriele Nespoli's PR235. Rohan Arun's PR243 introduced the `eta = 10^-24` backoff; its Anthropic Claude disclosure is retained. Existing notices for earlier suppliers and contributors remain in the pinned parent package. This transfer and its verification package were prepared by OpenAI Codex with substantial AI assistance; these credits do not imply endorsement by upstream contributors.

The inherited all-size compiler, weighted/common-ancestor chart, restored-row, selector, routing, exact-tape, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex symbolic-correctness, ordinary-leaf, and analytic-transfer interfaces remain assumptions. CI checks the finite construction and certificate; it does not discharge those theorem interfaces or establish an unconditional bound.
